title: PickList
lead: PickList is used to reorder items between different lists..

examples.name: Basic
prose: OrderList is used as a controlled input with source, target and onChange properties. Content of a list item needs to be defined with the itemTemplate property that receives an object in the list as parameter.

examples.name: Filter
prose: Items are filtered using an input field by enabling the filter property. Filter value is checked against the property of an object configured with the filterBy property and the filtering match mode with filterMatchMode e.g. contains.
